ToolsFasteningRatchets3054-20M12 FUEL™ 1/2" RatchetShareTool Options3054-20M12 FUEL™ 1/2" RatchetSpecsLoadingManualsParts ListProduct OverviewOur M12 FUEL™ 1/2" Ratchet redefines productivity, capability, & comfort for users looking for the ultimate cordless ratchet to tackle any job. Our new POWERSTATE™ Brushless outer rotor motor delivers the BEST COMBINATION OF POWER AND SPEED with 80 ft-lbs of torque to breakaway stubborn fasteners, & 300 RPM to remove and install fasteners at higher rates of speed. This solution also delivers the MOST COMPACT HEAD & BODY SIZE to allow users full body access into tight spaces, maintaining a 3/4" head profile & at only 1.7 lbs bare tool, without sacrificing durability. The M12 FUEL™ Ratchet provides users UNMATCHED COMFORT with a dedicated contoured grip & reduces fatigue during a full day of wrenching. Also featuring a new to world modular trigger cap, this will allow users to switch between various button or paddle trigger configurations for customizable comfort. Equipped with a targeted LED work light, battery isolation system, and & optimized forward reverse shuttle – this ratchet tackles core user frustrations and delivers uncompromising performance.Up to 80 ft-lbs of max torque300 RPM for faster application speedsMost Compact head & body size for increased access to tight spacesContoured Grip for Unmatched comfortModular trigger for personalized grip point - button & paddle cap includedRaised F/R shuttle for easier direction changesIntegrated Grease Port for Self LubricationMetal reinforced housing for increased durabilityPOWERSTATE™ Brushless Outer Rotor Motor for greatest performanceREDLINK PLUS™ intelligence prevents damage to the tool & battery due to overloading or overheatingBi-Directional Motor Firmware for consistent breakaway torqueTargeted LED light for greater illuminationPart of the M12™ System featuring 150+ ToolsProduct DocumentsManual / Parts ListPN0007646PN0007658ReviewsAdditional ResourcesManualsWarrantyParts ListFix My ToolExplore the systems3054-20M12 FUEL™ 1/2" RatchetShare© 2026 by Milwaukee Tool.
